name: Old Ironforge Incursion
summary: Earthseer Farsen directs the final stage of an investigation into Dark Iron infiltrators beneath Ironforge. You enter the Hall of Thanes under Old Ironforge to confront the threat and report to King Magni Bronzebeard.

sections.title: Breaching the Vaults
sections.body: After an underground map reveals Dark Iron movements, Earthseer Farsen identifies the mastermind behind the intrusion. The entrance to the Hall of Thanes lies deep within Old Ironforge's ancient stone halls. While the upper city attends to matters above, forces have slipped into the dormant caverns beneath the kingdom.

sections.title: Durgen Dirgehammer
sections.body: Earthseer Farsen's translation of captured Dark Iron documents names the commander directing the operation: Durgen Dirgehammer. He is deep in the lower vaults, a threat to the heart of the Bronzebeard mountain kingdom. You must reach him, strike him down, and carry his severed head to King Magni Bronzebeard above.

sections.title: Audience with the King
sections.body: Durgen Dirgehammer's head confirms to King Magni Bronzebeard the Dark Iron threat beneath the city's ancient roots. You bring proof of victory and a personal greeting from Farsen, his old friend. The investigation ends with Magni aware of what lurks below.

faq.answer: Old Ironforge Incursion is the final stage of an investigation into Dark Iron activity beneath Dun Morogh. Earthseer Farsen sends you into the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge to slay their commander, Durgen Dirgehammer.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You enter the Hall of Thanes, an ancient chamber beneath Old Ironforge, deep in the bedrock under the mountain capital.
Durgen Dirgehammer commands the Dark Iron incursion into the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge. Earthseer Farsen learned his name from recovered Dark Iron documents.

faq.q: Who gives the quest, and who receives it?
aliases: who turns in old ironforge incursion
faq.answer: Earthseer Farsen gives you the task after the Underground Map is recovered. You deliver it directly to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

faq.q: How do I start the quest chain that leads to this?
aliases: how to start hall of thanes quest
faq.answer: Begin with A Visitor to Dun Morogh, offered by Beldin Steelgrill outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What is the connection between Earthseer Farsen and King Magni?
faq.answer: Earthseer Farsen considers himself an old friend of King Magni Bronzebeard. He asks you to send his personal regards when you present Durgen Dirgehammer's head in the throne room.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know Dark Iron infiltrators in the forgotten vaults beneath the High Seat have violated your ancestral fortress.
As an Alliance member, you help stop an incursion that threatens a devastating surprise attack on your faction's primary stronghold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
